label: Столько
description: A 10-sentence usage card for столько (so much; so many; that much).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: A large amount with genitive. 'Столько' takes the genitive 'работы' to mean so much work. As a correlative quantity word it governs the genitive just like 'много'.

missions.phrase: Я никогда не видел столько людей.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Emphatic large count. 'Столько' governs the genitive plural 'людей' to stress so many people. It emphasises an impressively high number in exclamatory speech.
Strategic focus: The correlative pair. 'Столько' answers 'сколько', forming a correlative structure meaning take as much as you want. The pair links a quantity to its measure across two clauses.
Strategic focus: Reproachful quantity. 'Столько' takes the genitive 'денег' to mean so much money. In a question it often carries surprise or disapproval at the amount.
Strategic focus: Genitive of a substantivised adjective. 'Столько' governs the genitive 'интересного' to mean so much interesting material. It can take a neuter adjective acting as a noun.
Strategic focus: A mass quantity. 'Столько' takes the genitive singular 'снега' to mean so much snow. With mass nouns it pairs with the genitive singular to convey a striking amount.
Strategic focus: Unexpected count. 'Столько' governs the genitive plural 'вопросов' for so many questions. It expresses that the number exceeded what the speaker anticipated.
Strategic focus: Quantity inside a phrase. 'Столько' takes the genitive plural 'добрых слов' to mean so many kind words. Even within a prepositional phrase, its complement stays genitive.
Strategic focus: Regret over an amount. 'Столько времени' uses the genitive singular 'времени' for so much time. The word stresses how large the wasted quantity feels in hindsight.
Strategic focus: Matching an amount. 'Столько же' means the same amount, with 'же' marking equivalence to something already mentioned. It requests a quantity equal to a previous one.
